name: harness-vscode
description: Run the AI Engineering Harness from the editor: inline diff, context picking, status bar, approve/reject.

harness.serverUrl.description: Orchestrator base URL. Identity is derived from harness.identityUrl.

harness.maxContextChars.description: Hard cap on the context block sent with a goal. Larger selections are reduced and the goal says so.

harness.repoRoot.description: Path to the harness repo whose deploy/runners/local_engine.py executes the confined run (required to run).

harness.launcherPython.description: Interpreter with the harness SDK importable (e.g. section1/.venv/bin/python). Defaults to python3.

harness.runTimeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock deadline for one confined engine run.

scripts.package: npm run bundle && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@3.2.1 package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license -o harness-vscode.vsix
